title: Distributed Consensus Polarity Ring (5-Node Odd Mobius Z/2Z Torsion Trap)

claims.description: Node 0 and Node 1 have opposite polarity (x_0 + x_1 = 0)
Node 1 and Node 2 have opposite polarity (x_1 + x_2 = 0)
Node 2 and Node 3 have opposite polarity (x_2 + x_3 = 0)
Node 3 and Node 4 have opposite polarity (x_3 + x_4 = 0)
Odd Mobius twist: x_4 + x_0 = 1 (forces 2*x_0 = 1 -> Z/2Z torsion; float64/Q accept x_0 = 0.5!)
